lines.en: : Sensei! I’m glad you decided to drop by.
: I actually have a few questions about what you think I could improve on as the class representative...
lines.zh: : 我其实有几个问题，想听听你觉得我作为班长还能改进什么……

lines.en: Makoto and I talk about[school] for a few minutes before she has to leave for work.
lines.zh: 我和 Makoto 聊了几分钟[学校]的事，然后她得去上班了。

lines.en: It never ceases to amaze me how dedicated she is to improving herself even during her off-time.
lines.zh: 她连休息时间都这么用心提升自己，我每次都还是会被惊到。

lines.en: If I was even half as productive as that, I’d probably be in an entirely different position right now.
lines.zh: 如果我有她一半的效率，现在大概完全会是另一番处境。

lines.en: It’s funny how {i}I’m{/i} the one being looked up to when she could probably teach this class even better than me."
lines.zh: 有意思的是，被仰望的人居然是{i}我{/i}——而她说不定比我更会教这个班。"

lines.en: The two of us talk for another few minutes before she decides it’s best to head out.
lines.zh: 我们又聊了几分钟，她才决定该走了。

lines.en: Being the gentleman I am, I walk her out of the dorm and make sure she’s in a nice area before the two of us separate."
lines.zh: 身为绅士，我送她出了宿舍，确认她到了安全的地方，我们才分开。"
